metadata.methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded during a categorized free recall task involving word list encoding, arithmetic distraction, and free recall. Closed-loop stimulation was delivered to a single electrode during encoding when an L2 logistic regression classifier, trained on spectral power features (Morlet wavelet transform, 3-180 Hz, 60 Hz line noise removed via Butterworth filter) from prior catFR1 sessions, predicted low likelihood of subsequent recall. Classifier performance was validated via leave-one-session-out cross-validation with permutation testing, and stimulation thresholds were set using Youden's J statistic. Recordings were labeled as monopolar or bipolar, with electrode locations provided in MNI and Talairach coordinates.
